versions.changelog:
headful-browser-vnc v1.0.2

- Added .gitignore and LICENSE for repo hygiene and licensing clarity.
- Added README.md with detailed usage, capabilities, and security guidance.
- Added Jinja2 systemd unit templates for x11vnc and noVNC (templates/novnc.service.j2, templates/x11vnc.service.j2).
- Introduced environment variable requirements in SKILL.md frontmatter.
- No breaking changes; all additions are documentation and template files for system and operator support.

headful-browser-vnc 1.0.1

- Replaced docker-based setup with script- and template-based configuration (removed docker-compose and entrypoint, added setup.sh).
- Added templates for systemd services (novnc.service.j2, x11vnc.service.j2) for easier host integration.
- Introduced Playwright automation export helper (tools/playwright_export.js).
- Added LICENSE file.
- Included a smoke test script for basic validation.
- Updated documentation in SKILL.md to reflect new setup process and runtime file structure.

Initial public release of headful-browser-vnc.

- Provides an auditable, headful Chromium browsing environment for server-side automation with optional human intervention via VNC/noVNC.
- Allows operators to securely access, interact, and troubleshoot live browser sessions for automation edge cases (e.g., CAPTCHA, authentication).
- Exposes programmatic capture capabilities: export rendered HTML, screenshots, and cookies for downstream workflows.
- Highlights operational hygiene: secure artifact handling, session control, and explicit operator consent for privileged actions.
- Includes installer, session management scripts, and Dockerfile/template examples for flexible deployment.
